Goal: ordinary PAL inputs are understood by a reasoning-model Primary, which proposes supported work or asks a natural essential question. Keyword routing and an unsafe latest-Goal answer shortcut currently prevent that behavior.

Authority: latest direct owner instruction, D-028/D-029 and completed official Opus design review. Qwen3.8-27B is the reference capability; actual PAL qualification is not yet proven. Local-draft-only tools, host canonical authority, fixed criteria, reference-stop, recovery, mock default and bounded no-extra-charge access stay intact.

Acceptance: N1-10 plus affected N1-01–09/S0/F0 regression. One closed proposal per ordinary input, no lexical preemption/fallback, atomic source/snapshot/revision/epoch validation, original answer/source memory, replay without extra effect/call, visible interrupted inference, and immediate explicit UI controls. Model output is never canonical evidence. No physical purge, automatic retry, new provider permission/payment or external send.

Work units:
- [x] Reviewed durable Primary admission/proposal/commit boundary and fault tests.
- [x] Model-led conversation/local draft/answer integration.
- [x] Control/correction/remember/reference-stop on the same boundary.
- [ ] Frozen actual-model functional checks and handoff to release Issue #5.

Each unit: test → minimal implementation → verify → evidence → commit/push → evaluate contribution → next. Evidence begins at evidence/reviews/judgment-boundary/. Human micro-approvals are withdrawn; one genuine end-to-end usefulness evaluation occurs only when the working candidate is ready. Future plan proposal adoption does not block this authorized work. Parent #2, global goal #6, active milestone1. Do not close merely for review completion or mock PASS.

C029 implementation: pushed candidate `1a14de986de2756ffea83c2671e506a32cccfdf6`, full196 tests PASS16.599s and shipped-JS synthetic controls/receipt tests PASS. Source-stop replay fix and original failing evidence retained. Implementation checkboxes do not prove model semantics or actual UI. Frozen12-case/24-turn actual Primary qualification and revised real UI/Expert path remain unfinished. Evidence: evidence/reviews/judgment-boundary/primary-runtime-full-release.txt, primary-ui-green.txt, primary-candidate-freeze.json.

body:
## Project goal
Deliver a private personal PAL that retains relevant conversational context, accepts natural requests, asks only indispensable human judgments/content, prepares authorized reversible local results, verifies outcomes and returns results/blockers/decisions without requiring the user to manage internal tasks.

## Authority and plan
G-001 governance is ACTIVE by direct owner instruction. Stable-1 independently ACTIVE under D-021, adopted P002, and the latest owner-directed D028/D029 model-led Primary correction. Canonical decisions: DECISIONS.md; continuation: STATE.md. Reasoning-solvable technical choices remain autonomous. P-001 v2 is the latest frozen PROPOSED future plan (docs/plans/P-001-v2.md, SHA256 d7b931b06246a9a56be0f22234e309a99e2d4b4e90da25f6ac66226ddfcd5397); future activation is dormant until a concrete material scope decision is needed, not a blocker for current work. No future scope adoption is inferred.

## Project acceptance
G-P01: every required adopted milestone gate with release-version evidence PASS.
G-P02: precommitted integrated workloads/rubric prove context → recall → request → necessary question → local preparation → verified return, not just isolated components.
G-P03: control/security/forget/recovery/bounded official cost and blocker audit hold at integration.
G-P04: authentic human overall usefulness, final suite/version/use/limits record and project-goal audit before closure.
All project gates are NOT_RUN until the plan is adopted and demonstrated. Closed child issues are not project completion. Stable-0 completion remains intact, not overall completion.

## Goal loops and checkpoints
Each Issue: goal/criteria/dependencies → bounded unit → required review → test/implement/verify/evidence/commit/push → evaluate unit contribution → next unmet condition. Close only after objective verification. Milestone aggregates but independently verifies its user-visible promise. Project independently verifies integrated usefulness.
Checkpoints: coherent green unit, Issue exit, milestone exit/entry, and defect/repeated cause/user feedback/assumption failure. Record goal verdict, evidence/version, remaining uncertainty, plan impact and exact next step. No timer/checkpoint keepalive.

## Plan changes
Material plan/scope/acceptance/priority change: Opus discuss/agreement → versioned proposal with evidence/delta/recommendation/affected vs independent work → actual targeted human decision → canonical docs/GitHub activation. Pending decision blocks only its dependencies. Routine technical choices/bug fixes within approved scope remain autonomous. Only ACTIVE approved milestones enter execution.

## Next
Stable-1 #12 model-led Primary implementation is pushed at1a14de9, full196 deterministic tests PASS plus shipped-JS synthetic controls/receipt checks. Next: frozen actual-model Primary qualification, revised real UI/Expert functional proof, one authentic end-to-end usefulness evaluation, then #5 final candidate audit/private release. HR-INPUT/P003 form-only/wording wait is withdrawn under D028; old wrong-target behavior is a development defect, not an owner questionnaire. Earlier live evidence remains historical to its candidate.

Private Projects board https://github.com/users/thattor/projects/1 is created, linked and populated; HR-PERM is fulfilled, no device authorization wait. Overall goal remains incomplete. Qwen3.8-27B is the owner's capability reference, not yet PAL-qualified. No new authentication, cost, external sending/publication, old soak quota or scheduled wake is authorized by these records.
